correctness.rationale: C: For a multilinear polynomial, matrix-unit evaluations determine all evaluations. The encoded binary matrix is therefore exactly the degree-eight evaluation map. Because the matrix entries lie in F2, extension to any infinite characteristic-two field preserves rank.
